title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01

source: Source: taped and remastered by Monte Barry; Nakamichi 550 portable stereo cassette recorder; taped with Dolby NR on Maxell UD C90 normal bias cassettes Sony ECM-99 single-point stereo mic; mic is hand-held on mic-stand shaft, with arm raised up, FOB;

ai_review.summary: Warm yet not especially clear audience recording of a powerful 1973 show highlighted by an epic Dark Star>El Paso>Eyes>Dew sequence.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the transcendent second‑set stretch that weaves Dark Star into El Paso, Eyes of the World and Dew, calling it one of the band’s most powerful moments. The audience tape captures a spacious, immersive wall of sound but suffers from limited clarity, making it less suitable for casual listening though its warmth shines through.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is praised for a standout Dark Star sequence and overall power; recording quality is described as warm but lacking clarity, yielding a mixed weighted rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm and immersive sound that hits from all directions, but not distinct or clear enough for car stereos; occasional muddiness noted.

standout_songs: Dark Star > El Paso > Eyes of the World > Dew
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set considered unremarkable, while the second set delivers a gem with the extended Dark Star sequence, creating a powerful overall experience despite an uneven start.
